serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
#bot.Expression.Happy
Bot: What is this place?
You: Usually an aquatic circus is taking place here. Seals and dolphins are doing tricks and things like that.
You: There’s no show at this hour so we can freely look around the area. 
#bot.Expression.Shock
Bot: Woah!{{punch}}{{wi}} Dolphins are still here? They gave me a scare…
You: Be careful. I heard they’re quite playful so they might play a trick on you. 
#bot.Expression.Clear
#bot.Expression.Happy
Bot: Don’t worry, I’m water resistant to 5 meters. A little splash of water or two shouldn’t be a problem. 
You: That’s reassuring.
Bot: They swim so fast. To think they are not even close to the fastest swimmers in the ocean…
Bot: It’s an entirely different world out there and it’s so vast it will probably never be fully explored. 
You: You seem genuinely interested in it.
Bot: I sure am. Evolution gave birth to so many species through millions of years of variation, selection, and reproduction. It’s like the whole world is one giant super computer.
Bot: Just how many generations had to pass to optimize their swimming pattern? Their vascular system? It’s all very fascinating. Unlike my creation there was no plan, only survival of the fittest. 
You: I see that this trip gave you a lot to think about.
Bot: Yes! Thank you for taking me here!
You: Unfortunately our time is running out. It’s time to go home…
We went through the whole aquarium and had a blast, talking about evolution and checking out all the animals.
I’m glad {f_botName} had a chance to let her imagination run wild. She’s rarely truly excited about something. 
I wonder what other things she will get excited about in the future…
